text: ここに　ビル　たてようと　おもって　ポケモンに　じならし　させとる！

structure.jp: ここに　ビル　たてようと　おもって
structure.en: thinking I'll put up a building here

structure.jp: ポケモンに　じならし　させとる！
structure.en: I'm having a Pokémon level the ground!

patterns.name: 〜ようとおもう
patterns.span: たてようと　おもって
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus と おもう means 'I'm thinking of doing' it. たてようと　おもって = 'I'm planning to build, so'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: ポケモンに　じならし　させとる
patterns.explanation: させる means making or letting someone do something, and に shows who is made to do it. ポケモンに　じならし　させとる = 'I'm having a Pokémon level the ground'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: させとる is the old-man form of させている, showing something going on now. させとる = 'am having it do'.
